Hi Patrícia, it is Karen. I read your handover note for Tom, and it is very good. Just two things before Friday. First, remember why handovers are a risk. Most of the customers who leave in the first year after a renewal leave after a change of manager, not after an outage. So please avoid disappearing on the day of the handover. I want you on the first two calls, and I have already told Tom to expect that. Second, I suggest adding one sentence at the end of the note: what this customer is afraid of. For Northwind, I think it is surprises. If Tom knows that, he will make the right decisions without asking you. And congratulations again on the new portfolio. You earned it.

Patrícia, it is David. Thank you for calling me before the email went out. I will be honest, I was worried when I heard. The last time our account manager changed, nobody told us for a month, and we only found out when a new name appeared on an invoice. So this is already better. I have one request. Please promise to stay on the first calls, so that Tom does not start from zero with us. And tell Tom that I am happy to show him the warehouse. If he sees the workflow in real life, he will understand our reports much faster. Congratulations on the new accounts. We will miss you on Thursdays.
